page_note: Page is severely damaged (73.7% lacuna ratio) but the surviving text is overwhelmingly cosmological substrate. Two distinct teaching sequences are visible: (1) segments 0-20 — the cosmic descent/restoration narrative involving First Man, Calling and Hearing, Living Spirit, the Ambassador (ⲡⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲧⲏⲥ) coming forth from the Father, the great kings fashioning the cosmos; (2) segments 24-37 — a 'beginning/source' enumeration mapping each category of cosmic activity onto a corresponding cosmic figure ('the beginning of every blessing is the Mother of Life'; 'the beginning of every honor is the Beloved of the Lights'; etc.). This second sequence is classic substrate enumeration — domain → cosmic figure correspondence, both sides internal. Only segment 24 is a clear dialogue-frame intrusion. The 'ⲓ̅ⲁ̅' (11) markers at 21/23 are structural chapter/kephalaion numbering. Editorial fatigue score is moderate but driven mostly by the late-page damage zone, not by genuine institutional drift.
